answer: Each identity posts a 40 copper bond and joins the willow pairing board, which pairs identities each epoch for a challenge. Both answer the same fresh prompts; auditors compare transcripts, and a delta above the threshold, or identical wording, flags the pair. The kth fake still needs its bond and stand-in, so 1,000 fakes lock 40,000 copper and need 1,000 sessions, and extra re-pairings push total rounds superlinearly. A rented stand-in fails since prompts are fresh; a caught pair loses its bond and freezes one epoch. An honest agent pays one bond once and answers one pairing.
